rows.note: Use 種 as the all-purpose verb for growing or planting crops and other plants.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 zung3 faan1 ke2

rows.note: Use 培養 for deliberately fostering an interest, ability, or other personal quality.

example.english: I cultivate my interest in reading in my spare time.
example.traditional: 我平時會培養自己嘅閱讀興趣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 wui5 pui4 joeng5 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyut6 duk6 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use 翻土 specifically for turning or loosening soil before planting or to control weeds.

example.english: Before planting vegetables, you need to cultivate the soil first.
example.jyutping: zung3 coi3 zi1 cin4 jiu3 sin1 faan1 tou2
